title: RoleFUZZER: User-Behaviour Fuzzing for Role-Specification Adherence in Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.38438v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are often conditioned into specific roles such as tutors, interviewers, or agents acting for an organisation, through system prompts that specify how they should behave. The extent to which they can actually adhere to these role specifications under multi-turn interactions with realistic and potentially problematic users is understudied. To address this, we propose user behaviour fuzzing, a guided search over plausible user behaviours that can lead a model to violate its role specification, and introduce RoleFUZZER, a framework that adapts coverage-guided fuzzing from software testing to operationalise the search. RoleFUZZER constructs scenarios guided by a user-behaviour coverage grid that crosses a grounded taxonomy of user interaction types and the role specification of the model under test i.e. what is under pressure. translated_title: RoleFUZZER：用于大语言模型角色规范遵守性测试的用户行为模糊测试
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）通常通过指定其行为方式的系统提示词被设定为特定角色，例如导师、面试官或代表组织行事的智能体。然而，在多轮交互中面对真实且可能存在问题的用户时，模型在多大程度上能够真正遵守这些角色规范，这方面的研究仍然不足。为解决这一问题，我们提出了用户行为模糊测试，即对可能导致模型违反其角色规范的合理用户行为进行引导式搜索，并引入 RoleFUZZER——一个改造软件测试中覆盖引导模糊测试方法来实现该搜索的框架。RoleFUZZER 在用户行为覆盖网格的指导下构建测试场景，该网格将由用户交互类型的有据可依的分类体系与被测模型的角色规范（即模型所受压力的方面）交叉组合而成。利用 RoleFUZZER，我们评估了大语言模型在五种角色规范下的表现，包括导师……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 提出 RoleFUZZER 框架，将软件测试中的覆盖引导模糊测试方法迁移至用户行为搜索，系统化地检测大语言模型在多轮真实交互中违反角色规范的行为。
en_tdlr: RoleFUZZER adapts coverage-guided fuzzing from software testing to systematically search for plausible user behaviors that cause LLMs to violate their role specifications during multi-turn interactions.
